purpose: Review the declared lag-linked binary process, exact joint stationary initialization, exogenous-mask interpretation and retained owned execution without approving a market model or scientific information target.

scope.authority: Implementation and model inquiry within research-contract/1.0 sections 5.3, 5.4 and 11; no change to estimator, scientific thresholds, calibration requirements or free discovery.

findings.finding: For positive lag d, a=q+e and b=q-q*e/(1-q) satisfy q*a+(1-q)*b=q. Independent stationary time phases and fresh innovations therefore define a stationary lag-d binary process with C_t=Y_(t-d) and conditional-minus-scope effect e under the declared mask assumptions.
findings.limits: The effect also fixes lag-k*d correlation to (e/(1-q))**k. Other phase correlations are zero, and the zero-effect latent law is IID over time. This is a specific hypothetical stress law, not an arbitrary dependent null, raw feature process, fitted market law or universal original-AST simulator.

findings.finding: The model distinguishes source condition fraction from generated w=r*q, where r is the eligible condition-known fraction. It preserves the existing observable p_other meaning as q-w*e/(1-w), while reporting latent transition b separately. Unknown conditions remain in the whole-scope baseline.
findings.independent_oracle: A two-instrument fixture with q=1/2 and r=13/14 yields w=13/28, p_true=3/5, latent b=2/5 and observed p_other=31/75 for e=1/10. Weighted observable group means return exactly q.
findings.limits: These identities require masks independent of the latent responses and homogeneous q across the pooled instruments. They do not establish exogeneity or homogeneity in market data. Original source condition values are not resampled or presented as preserved.

findings.finding: The solver integrates the product of coordinate probabilities conditional on a common uniform innovation, using an independent common-channel choice for each coordinate. It solves pi P=pi exactly, checks normalization/nonnegative mass and all residuals, and retains an exact integer sampling CDF.
independent_oracles: For q=1/2, effects [0,1/10] and common share 1, ascending low-bit-coordinate state probabilities are [9/20,1/20,1/20,9/20].
For the same transitions and common share 1/2, the probabilities are [3/10,1/5,1/5,3/10], distinguishing independent coordinate channel choices from one global channel choice.
Common share zero yields the exact product of different coordinate stationary marginals.
Four identical IID coordinates with full common share have mass 2/3 at state 0 and 1/3 at state 15, with zero mass on all intermediate states. The solver correctly permits transient joint states.
findings.process_argument: Strictly interior transitions give a positive probability of the same all-zero reset from every prior state, so all states reach the one closed stationary class. One independent exact joint-state draw per time phase initializes the process without a finite burn-in or successful-initialization selection.
findings.limits: The deterministic capability is one through four response-by-instrument coordinates, at most sixteen joint states and a 4096-bit arithmetic envelope. Strict-interior capability exclusions are distinguished from mathematically infeasible probabilities. This is not a proof that a finite PRNG realizes an ideal stochastic law.

findings.finding: Each response derives its condition from its own earlier generated latent value. Latent states advance on every timestamp, including fully missing rows; mask states, knownness and terminal censoring remain explicit. Initial states are retained before the rolling histories are mutated.
findings.independent_oracle: Controlled streams with two wholly missing intermediate rows require condition values [false,true,null,null,false,true,true,false]. This checks latent advancement through gaps, not merely agreement among visible pairs. A tampered model transition is rejected before any random stream is created.
findings.limits: The masks remain an exogenous sampled template and no original AST is executed. Different family responses are different synthetic components, not different real ASTs on one price path.

findings.finding: Only explicit new specification/model schemas select the added implementation. The previous generator code path is otherwise unchanged. The retained pre-edit package and current package produce identical complete old-law results and case bytes on the fixed compatibility observation.
findings.limits: Historical source packages are not migrated. Reuse of the existing owned capture/replay and family-study pipeline does not grant a scientific freeze, protected data authority or completed final calibration.

findings.finding: The 60000 ms and 64 MiB input is expressly an operator allowance estimate, despite the legacy observed_* field names. The host labels it retained_operator_input_not_authenticated_benchmark. Actual reservations, settlements and retained bytes are separately accounted.
findings.limits: These input figures are not measured performance and cannot establish efficiency or full-series feasibility. The observed family charges below include concurrent engineering execution and are not a comparative benchmark.
